## E-two — Competitive teardown

No competitor product covering Hawaii obeying officers and signs, driving on the right and when the left half may be used, passing on the right, lane use, following distance, divided highways, required signals, railroad crossings, speed rules, prohibited parking, tow-away zones, unattended vehicles, emergency vehicles, funeral processions, the slow-moving vehicle emblem, no-passing situations and right-of-way rules was reviewed, so this teardown names no rival, quotes no price, compares no structure and records no praise or complaint.

The adopt-and-beat analysis of the master template is explicitly out of scope for this handbook-section dossier; a future market pass with its own sources would own it.

Pedagogy, practice-item and coverage comparison tables are therefore absent by explicit scope choice, not by omission.

Disposition: teardown for this section is present as an explicit scoped statement, not as researched competitive evidence.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the obeying officers and signs, driving on the right and when the left half may be used, passing on the right, lane use, following distance, divided highways, required signals, railroad crossings, speed rules, prohibited parking, tow-away zones, unattended vehicles, emergency vehicles, funeral processions, the slow-moving vehicle emblem, no-passing situations and right-of-way rules rules on pages 26–32 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
